passages.Reviewer1_Comment3: The covariance treatment in Eqs. (8)-(9) needs further clarification. In particular, it is unclear whether the distance derivatives account for changes in the baryonic mass model as well as the radial coordinate. The author should clarify how distance and inclination uncertainties are incorporated and whether the parameter-dependent covariance is updated throughout the fitting procedure.
passages.Reviewer2_Comment2: Validate the treatment of distance and inclination uncertainties (Equations 8-9). The distance Jacobian appears to describe radial-coordinate rescaling, whereas distance changes also affect the baryonic velocity templates. Please derive the full residual Jacobians, specifying all quantities held fixed, and demonstrate that the adopted approximation captures the relevant dependencies. A comparison with explicit nuisance-parameter treatment or numerical uncertainty propagation would help establish its accuracy.
